# SOLVIXBIT

> SOLVIXBIT is a technology solutions company helping businesses build, automate, and scale through custom software engineering, AI workflows, SaaS platforms, headless ecommerce, and enterprise cloud systems.

SOLVIXBIT delivers end-to-end digital transformation and bespoke engineering. Our solutions combine deep domain expertise, sub-second edge performance, zero-technical-debt software craftsmanship, and deterministic AI systems that eliminate operational bottlenecks. We partner with fast-growing startups, mid-market leaders, and global enterprises.

- Primary Website: https://www.solvixbit.com
- Direct Contact: hello@solvixbit.com
- Project Discovery: https://www.solvixbit.com/start-a-project
- Contact Hub: https://www.solvixbit.com/contact
- Response Time SLA: Senior engineering partners respond within 24 hours
- Full Knowledge Index: https://www.solvixbit.com/llms-full.txt

## Core Services

- [Custom Software Development](https://www.solvixbit.com/services/software-development): Architecting and engineering high-throughput web applications, microservices, distributed APIs, and cloud-native systems built with TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, Go, PostgreSQL, and AWS.
- [AI & Workflow Automation](https://www.solvixbit.com/services/ai-automation): Deploying autonomous business agents, custom RAG knowledge pipelines, document intelligence, and multi-step process automations using LangChain, OpenAI, Claude, Pinecone, and n8n.
- [SaaS & Digital Product Engineering](https://www.solvixbit.com/services/saas-development): End-to-end multi-tenant SaaS architectures, subscription billing, RBAC, analytics engines, and zero-to-one digital products designed for scale.
- [Headless Web & Modern Ecommerce](https://www.solvixbit.com/services/web-ecommerce): High-conversion headless storefronts, Shopify Plus custom apps, Next.js Commerce, sub-second checkout, and omnichannel retail platforms.
- [Connected Systems & API Integration](https://www.solvixbit.com/services/api-integrations): Enterprise ERP, CRM, payment gateway, and third-party webhook synchronizations with guaranteed data consistency and fault-tolerant queues.
- [Cloud & Infrastructure Engineering](https://www.solvixbit.com/services/cloud-integrations): AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, automated CI/CD pipelines, Terraform IaC, and 99.99% uptime cloud architectures.
- [Data Intelligence & Decision Systems](https://www.solvixbit.com/services/data-analytics): Real-time analytics dashboards, ETL pipelines, predictive forecasting models, and executive decision-support systems.
- [Application Security & Quality](https://www.solvixbit.com/services/security-quality): SOC 2 readiness, penetration testing, automated end-to-end testing, zero-trust access control, and OWASP compliance auditing.
- [Mobile & Cross-Platform Development](https://www.solvixbit.com/services/mobile-engineering): Native-performance iOS and Android mobile applications using React Native and Flutter with offline sync and push notifications.

## Industry Solutions

- [Enterprise Architecture & Modernization](https://www.solvixbit.com/solutions/enterprise-scale): Strangler fig migration, monolithic deconstruction, microservices decoupling, and zero-downtime database modernization.
- [Operational & Process Automation](https://www.solvixbit.com/solutions/operational-automation): Eliminating repetitive manual administrative bottlenecks with autonomous AI copilots and automated document extraction.
- [Zero-to-One Startup MVP](https://www.solvixbit.com/solutions/startup-mvp): Rapid 6-to-10 week production MVP builds for venture-backed and bootstrapped founders with clean, investor-ready code.
- [High-Conversion Global Commerce](https://www.solvixbit.com/solutions/high-conversion-commerce): International multi-currency ecommerce architectures with sub-100ms global CDN latency and optimized cart funnels.
- [Connected Systems & Integration Hub](https://www.solvixbit.com/solutions/connected-systems-api-integration): Connecting fragmented legacy software, Salesforce, HubSpot, SAP, NetSuite, and custom accounting databases.
- [Data Intelligence & Decision Systems](https://www.solvixbit.com/solutions/data-intelligence-decision-systems): Centralized data warehouses, BI pipelines, and executive forecasting tools.
- [Cloud Reliability & DevOps Engineering](https://www.solvixbit.com/solutions/cloud-engineering-reliability): Auto-scaling container clusters, disaster recovery runbooks, and 24/7 telemetry monitoring.
- [Digital Experience & UI/UX Design](https://www.solvixbit.com/solutions/digital-experience-conversion): Conversion-optimized interfaces, comprehensive Figma design systems, and WCAG AA accessible web apps.
- [Application Security & Compliance](https://www.solvixbit.com/solutions/application-security-quality): Zero-trust security, encrypted transactional flows, and vulnerability remediation.
- [B2B Portals & Workflow Platforms](https://www.solvixbit.com/solutions/b2b-portals-workflow-platforms): Self-service partner portals, vendor extranets, and custom internal operations operating systems.

## Case Studies & Proven Results

- [Fintech Real-Time Payment Engine](https://www.solvixbit.com/work/fintech-payment-engine): Engineered a fault-tolerant payment processing pipeline handling $42M+ in monthly transaction volume with sub-120ms settlement latency and 99.999% uptime.
- [Headless Global Ecommerce Scale](https://www.solvixbit.com/work/ecommerce-headless-scale): Replatformed an international luxury brand to Next.js and headless Shopify, cutting page load time by 68% and boosting mobile conversion by 34%.
- [Enterprise AI Copilot & Knowledge System](https://www.solvixbit.com/work/enterprise-ai-copilot): Deployed an internal RAG-grounded operations copilot for 450+ employees, reducing tier-1 support tickets by 58% and saving 1,400 hours monthly.

## Technical Architecture & Preferred Stack

- Frontend: Next.js 15 (App Router, Server Components), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- Backend: Node.js, Go, Python (FastAPI), Serverless Edge Functions
- Databases: PostgreSQL, Supabase, Redis, Pinecone (Vector DB)
- AI & Automation: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, LangChain, n8n, Enterprise RAG
- Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS (ECS, RDS, S3, CloudFront), Vercel, Docker, GitHub Actions CI/CD
- Security & Compliance: SOC 2 compliance readiness, OWASP Top 10 hardening, role-based access control (RBAC), end-to-end data encryption

## Engagement & Collaboration Model

- Project Scope Sprint: 1 to 2 weeks architectural scoping, technical specification, and milestone definition.
- Dedicated Engineering Pods: Senior full-stack engineers and solutions architects embedded directly into client workstreams.
- Fixed-Scope or Dedicated Monthly Retainers: Transparent pricing with clear deliverables, weekly demos, and production deployments.
- Discovery Inquiries: Submit project specifications at https://www.solvixbit.com/start-a-project or email hello@solvixbit.com.
